components.text:
Circle: medium circle, infernal chalk.

Curses the owner of the taglock: every half minute or so they see something that is not there (a figure, a whisper, a darkening). It shortens with the curse's strength.

Anyone can cast it. The target is the owner of the taglock. It only draws on their own screen: nothing on the server changes.

The curse ends when the target dies. It needs infernal chalk, not ritual chalk.
